devices.name: Galaxy A26
devices.review: "Sleek design with an IP67 rating and the longest software support in its price range — six years of OS updates. The main trade-off is a rear camera that doesn't quite keep pace with rivals, and there's no charger in the box."

devices.name: Galaxy S25 Ultra
devices.review: Sharper zoom, brighter outdoor screen and noticeably longer battery life than last year's model. The S-Pen still feels like an afterthought for most buyers.

devices.name: iPhone 17 Pro
devices.review: The camera system is the most consistent in low light we've tested this year. Battery life is strong, though the always-on display still dims more than it needs to.

devices.name: OnePlus 13R
devices.review: Best value flagship-lite this quarter — the charging speed alone makes it hard to go back to anything slower.
